scope: two independent extensions of original fixed128 Train Fit capacity experiments only

initialization.mode: weight continuation with newly initialized AdamW; NOT exact optimizer/sampler resume
initialization.sampler: same fixed128 selection order; deterministic RNG reset using dataset seed+10000

training.loss: original-scale average four layer BOS MSE; layer offsets[-1,-2,-3,-4]; 1024 dimensions each

selection: exact128 indices and order in original selected_fit_manifest.csv; no new text, tokenization or targets

evaluation.aggregation: FP32 element squared error accumulated FP64 / (128*1024), mean four layers
evaluation.feature_compatibility_necessary_conditio: each layer RMSE <= 1e-4; unchanged; not sufficient to claim original full parity or XP04 probability parity

stop_rule.otherwise: stop at2000, describe operational plateau/no sufficient improvement in this window
stop_rule.final_plateau_description: at5000 report4500->5000 relative decrease; descriptive only; no further extension
stop_rule.no_other_early_stop: except numerical/resource/program failure, retain failure evidence

checkpointing: save new model+optimizer/RNG/sampler at2000 and final; do not write original500 model; no old optimizer/RNG state exists
smoke: two newly added steps501-502 in isolated smoke dir, then formal reloads original500 weights, not smoke weights
resource_rationale: old perrun peak5.683GiB and sustained compute; two on one12GiB card leaves about0.63GiB headroom and likely contention; use two idle TITAN Xp cards preserving batch and precision
